name: DPS
recent: DPS Resources Berhad 近期出现多项股权变动申报，涉及董事与大股东；同时因雇员认股计划行使及凭单转换而分批发新股。最新季度净利同比增长44.4%至约224.5万令吉，但营收同比下滑9.4%。
notable: 雇员认股计划行使，发行1,994,000股新股，发行价每股RM0.39，上市日2026年11月4日。
凭单C转换，发行1,700,000股新股，发行价每股RM0.55，上市日2026年11月10日。
执行主席Tan Sri Dr Sow Chin Chuan在闭市期前申报有意交易公司股份。
risks: 董事与大股东近期有多项股权变动申报，具体增减持方向未在标题中说明。
雇员认股计划及凭单转换持续发行新股，可能摊薄现有股东持股。
earnings: 2026年6月30日季度营收为1,158万令吉，环比下降11.2%，同比下降9.4%；净利为224.5万令吉，同比增长44.4%，净利率19.4%，较上季的-12.7%转正。

recent_en: DPS Resources Berhad recently saw multiple shareholding change filings by directors and substantial shareholders, alongside new share issuances from ESOS exercises and warrant conversions. Latest quarter net profit rose 44.4% YoY to about RM2.245 million, while revenue fell 9.4% YoY.
notable_en: ESOS exercise issued 1,994,000 new shares at RM0.39 each, listed on 4 Nov 2026.
Conversion of Warrants-C issued 1,700,000 new shares at RM0.55 each, listed on 10 Nov 2026.
Executive Chairman Tan Sri Dr Sow Chin Chuan declared intention to deal in company shares during the closed period.
risks_en: Multiple recent shareholding change filings by directors and substantial shareholders; direction of change not specified in titles.
Ongoing new share issuance from ESOS and warrant conversions may dilute existing shareholders.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM11.58 million, down 11.2% QoQ and 9.4% YoY; net profit was RM2.245 million, up 44.4% YoY, with net margin at 19.4% versus -12.7% in the prior quarter.
